title: First-semester enrollment opens August 4
message: Freshman and transferee slots for the College of Business, Education, Engineering & IT, and Health Sciences are now open for the incoming school year.

title: Nursing program posts 96% board exam pass rate
message: Forty-one of LGC's forty-three examinees passed the June Nursing Licensure Examination, well above the national passing average.

title: Engineering students complete barangay water audit
message: Third-year Civil Engineering students partnered with the local government to survey water access across four barangays in Oriental Mindoro.
